# NSFWJS

> NSFWJS is a free, open-source (MIT) JavaScript library for client-side NSFW image detection. It runs a TensorFlow.js model in the browser or Node.js, so images never leave the device. Maintained by Infinite Red.

Install: `npm install nsfwjs @tensorflow/tfjs`

```js
import * as nsfwjs from "nsfwjs";
const model = await nsfwjs.load(); // "MobileNetV2" | "MobileNetV2Mid" | "InceptionV3"
const predictions = await model.classify(imgElement);
```

Categories: Drawing, Hentai, Neutral, Porn, Sexy. Accuracy: ~90% (MobileNetV2), ~93% (MobileNetV2Mid).
